answer: The strongest single control I know for this is light client proof of MegaETH state, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. Faking 379 identities means 379 fresh proofs and 36005 POA at risk, while the honest path risks nothing but a few minutes. The jetty sits in the mechanism itself, the ridge sits in the price of faking it, and the trellis sits in the record no template can forge. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
